## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Type checking and production build pass.
- [ ] Container smoke check passes.
- [ ] Relevant desktop/mobile and keyboard checks completed.
- [ ] No credentials or unrelated changes included.

For a release PR from develop to main:

- [ ] Preview revision, image digest and source commit recorded.
- [ ] Owner reviewed the preview and limitations.
- [ ] Previous production revision recorded for rollback.
- [ ] Production promotion remains a separate explicit approval.
